This URL is kept for compatibility. The documentation is now organized by the capability an agent needs instead of one catch-all section.

## Choose a section

- [Tools](/tools/) covers callable operations, discovery, workflows, and sites.
- [Skills](/skills/) covers reusable operating guidance and capability packages.
- [Steering](/steering/) covers the instructions loaded before work begins.
- [Memory](/memory/) covers workpads, handoffs, streams, saved memory, and durable files.
- [Secure](/secure/) covers approvals, credentials, permissions, and network boundaries.
- [Observe](/observe/) covers traces, tool calls, artifacts, logs, and debugging.

## How the pieces fit

A tool performs one typed operation. A skill teaches an agent how to combine operations for a kind of work. Steering says how the workspace should be operated. Memory carries state that another agent may need later. Workflows coordinate repeated multi-step work, while Secure and Observe define the execution boundaries and the evidence left behind.

A normal agent path is still:

```text
get_steering
  → discover a tool or load a skill
  → call typed tools
  → produce files or artifacts
  → inspect the trace
```

Use the top-level sections above for current documentation. Existing `/build/...` detail URLs remain available so links and in-flight documentation work do not break during the information-architecture change.
